propositions: A class may name an unreachable model (down endpoint or throttled provider) and currently fails the gate outright with no fallback option.

The feature constructs pydantic-ai's FallbackModel from inline model configs in a class's fallback array, with fallback_on predicate narrowed to availability/rate-limit errors where switching providers helps.
Fallback entries must honor endpoint configuration and build through the same provider path as the primary, with all clients registered on a single ProviderSession and closed exactly once.

Capabilities are computed as the conservative intersection across primary and all fallback candidates before the FallbackModel wrapper is built, and capabilities_for is never called on the wrapper itself.
The fallback_on predicate is derived from failure.py's _RETRYABLE frozenset plus CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL, firing on RETRY_NOW and WAIT_AND_RETRY but not on CHANGE_SETTINGS or CHANGE_INPUT errors.
Provider provenance records ordered candidates and ran_model read from ModelResponse.model_name, so a verdict produced by a fallback does not attest to the primary model.
